device.helpNoHost: Devdy machines online on your relay
device.emptyCheck: On the machine to pull from, check that it:

options.from: From {name} · ticked items overwrite what is on this machine
options.passwordHint: The master password set on {name} (Settings → Devices). Data is encrypted end to end.
options.failed: Sync from {name} failed — nothing was changed.
options.keepLocal: Items only on this machine are kept.

rules.todos: Overwritten by todo, every field included (Focus, due date, project).
rules.secretNotes: Stay sealed with their vault password; merged like a vault import.
rules.slackThreads: Threads, messages and translations; attachments are downloaded again.
rules.skillsRules: Matched by name, with their groups and files.
rules.projects: Only projects with the same name as one here; their settings, not their files.
rules.settings: Theme, language, models, saved prompts, translation…
rules.mcpServers: Full settings, secret env and headers included.
rules.vpsServers: Full settings, passphrases and Devdy-managed keys included.
rules.accounts: GitHub, GitLab, Google with tokens. Claude/AWS/Azure names only — sign in again.

running.title: Syncing {n} items from {name}…
running.keepOpen: Keep both devices awake until it finishes.

result.reloginHint: Claude, AWS and Azure accounts need to sign in again on this machine.
result.reloadHint: Reload Devdy to apply the synced theme and settings everywhere.

errors.wrong_password: The master password of {name} is wrong. Enter the master password set in Settings → Devices on {name} — not the one of this machine. After 5 wrong tries within 5 minutes, {name} locks syncing for about 5 minutes.
errors.device_offline: Cannot connect to {name}. Open Devdy on that machine and check that Remote Control is on; if it still fails, turn Remote Control off and on again on {name}.
errors.device_disconnected: {name} disconnected during the sync. Pick a device again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many wrong master passwords: {name} is locked for about 5 minutes. Wait about 5 minutes, then try again. Logging in to the web controller of {name} is locked during that time too.
errors.checksum_mismatch: The downloaded data was corrupted. Nothing was changed — try again.
errors.timeout: The device took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.source_failed: {name} could not prepare its data. Check Devdy on that machine and try again.
errors.bad_request: {name} refused the request. Update Devdy on both machines and check that {name} has a master password set.
errors.bundle_corrupt: The data from {name} could not be opened. Nothing was changed — try again.
errors.bundle_unsupported_version: {name} runs a different Devdy version. Update Devdy on both machines.
errors.bundle_too_large: The data on {name} is too large to sync. Untick some items and try again.
errors.protocol_error: The two devices could not understand each other. Update Devdy on both machines.
errors.relay_not_configured: No relay is set up on this machine. Configure it in Settings → Devices.
errors.relay_unreachable: Cannot reach the relay. Check the network and the relay URL.
errors.relay_auth_failed: The relay rejected this machine. Check the relay auth token in Settings → Devices.
errors.relay_unsupported: The relay is too old for device sync. Update the relay server.
errors.busy: Another sync is already running. Wait for it to finish.

mirror.label: Mirror exactly (delete the rest)
mirror.hint: Items only on this machine are DELETED in: Todos, Notes, Skills & Rules (with groups), MCP, VPS, Accounts. Secret notes, Slack threads, projects and general settings are never deleted.

confirm.title: Delete items {name} doesn't have?
confirm.message: Items only on this machine will be deleted in:
confirm.neverDeleted: Secret notes, Slack threads, projects and general settings are never deleted. This cannot be undone.

warningGroups.folders: Project folders not on this machine ({n})
warningGroups.links: Links to items not on this machine ({n})

warnings.project_folder_missing: Project '{project}': folder {path} is not on this machine — settings saved, skills and rules not copied into the folder yet.
warnings.link_target_missing: Project '{project}': {kind} '{name}' is not on this machine, so it was not linked.
warnings.category_not_sent: {section}: the other device did not send this, nothing deleted.
warnings.category_empty_no_mirror: {section}: the other device has none, nothing deleted to be safe.

short.todos: Every field, Focus and due dates
short.secretNotes: Still locked by the vault password
short.skillsRules: By name, with groups and files

card.title: Sync between machines
card.help: Other machines can pull from this one with its master password while Remote Control is on.
card.needsRelay: Set up the relay first (Connection) to sync with other machines.
